metadata.description: Captured POST /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}/deployment — canonical docs say 201 with a BaseModel {id, uuid} body. Confirmed: id is 0 (deployments are UUID-identified, not integer-ID-identified) and the deployment uuid appears only in the body, never in a Location/self header. Shape confirmed against 26.4.0.0 live capture: identical {id: 0, uuid: "..."} body, status 201.
